intent: Syntax demonstration: increasing one presence contracts supporting space. All values below are invented construction examples, not learned preferences.

presence.why: Relative size compared with this demonstration's starting composition.

headingReference.why: An invented reference heading size in rem, chosen only to demonstrate the runtime.

gapReference.why: An invented reference gap in rem, not a recommended spacing value.

elasticity.why: A reciprocal relation makes the algebra easy to inspect; choose a relationship appropriate to the real design.

headingSize.why: Heading size follows the relative presence.

supportGap.why: Supporting space follows the declared relationship to presence.
